snippet.title: '최대 500만 원' 아이폰 듀오 흥행조짐? 예약 첫날부터 "내년 1월말 배송" (자막뉴스) / SBS
snippet.description:
애플의 첫 폴더블 스마트폰 '아이폰 듀오'가 300만 원이 넘는 가격에도 사전 예약 시작 직후부터 품절 행진을 이어가고 있습니다.

국내에서는 어제(16일) 오후 9시 아이폰 듀오의 사전 예약이 시작됐습니다.

쿠팡에서는 예약 시작 직후 준비된 자급제 물량이 모두 소진됐고, 애플 공식 온라인 스토어에서도 예약 물량이 빠르게 품절됐습니다.

예약 개시 초반에는 오는 23일 정식 출시일에 받을 수 있었지만, 11월과 12월 배송 물량까지 모두 소진되면서 예약 시작 약 25분 만에 모든 모델의 배송 예정일이 12월 중순까지 밀렸습니다.

A special report published by The Economic Times has highlighted his growing role as the “Southern States' Leader,” focusing on his vision for regional cooperation and economic growth. Naidu's ambitious vision is to transform South India into a $10 trillion economy by 2047. With southern states already contributing significantly to India's GDP, he believes that coordinated investments, technological collaboration, and stronger economic partnerships can help the region emerge as a global economic powerhouse. His proposals include a high-speed bullet train corridor connecting Amaravati, Bengaluru, and Chennai, a common logistics network, dry ports, and metro projects in Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada to strengthen connectivity and accelerate trade. He has also emphasized the importance of river interlinking, proposing the Godavari–Krishna–Penna–Cauvery river-linking project to address water shortages across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu by utilizing surplus Godavari floodwaters. Beyond economic development and water management, Naidu has called for a coordinated disaster management task force to help southern states respond collectively to cyclones, floods, and other natural disasters. He has also proposed a major spiritual and tourism circuit connecting prominent destinations such as Tirupati, Srisailam, Kanchipuram, Madurai, Rameswaram, and Mysuru. Through his focus on regional coordination, infrastructure development, economic integration, and shared challenges, Chandrababu Naidu is seeking to place South India on the global stage. snippet.title: When Innocence Meets Prejudice👇
snippet.description:
When Innocence Meets Prejudice👇

A little girl asks another if she’s Chinese, curious and open-hearted.

Her mother tries to gently connect their daughters, hoping for a simple moment of friendship.

But a cruel voice interrupts with a hateful insult, shutting down the chance before it even begins.

The adopted girl explains she was born in China, separated from her birth mother.

Her story isn’t just about heritage—it’s about identity and resilience.

Yet even innocence can be overshadowed by ignorance and prejudice.

👉 Curiosity can open doors to friendship, but intolerance quickly shuts them.

👉 Understanding someone’s background takes listening, empathy, and patience.

👉 Prejudice scars more deeply than words; kindness can help heal those wounds.

The uncomfortable truth?

Bias and cruelty often appear where we least expect it — even around children.

Assumptions and judgments can isolate those who are already vulnerable.

And while innocence tries to bridge gaps, prejudice fiercely holds them apart.

So the real question is:

How can we teach compassion early enough to break the cycle of exclusion?👇💬

Cada escena está llena de sorpresas y conexiones que enriquecen la experiencia visual.
